render.prompt: Locked-off 35 mm wide side view, static camera, no push, no zoom, no pan, one single unbroken twelve-second take from this one camera only. Start exactly from the first frame and continue the same continuous take without any cut; the camera never changes position, height or angle. The dirt path through the sunset forest with the wide deep hole in the middle of it, the young man in the lime-green bucket hat (soft, round-shouldered, heavy-set, washed-out grey hoodie, giant black headphones round his neck, baggy black cargo shorts, long white tube socks in black slides) at the top of a gleeful jump toward the hole with one gold coin held high, his can standing on the path at the right, and the explorer in the khaki safari jacket and pith helmet at the left walking calmly around the hole along its far edge. The young man drops into the hole and vanishes below its rim with a puff of dust. The explorer walks on along the path and out of the frame at the left without looking down. After a beat the lime-green bucket hat comes flying up out of the hole, turns over in the air and lands on the path beside the can, and a moment later one hand comes up over the rim, still holding the gold coin, and waves it once. Sound: birds, boots on dirt going away, a whoop cut short, a thud and a scatter of dirt, a groan from the hole, the hat landing.
